scope: PostgreSQL transactional outbox and simulated publisher leases; no broker/consumer deployment
checks: rollback removes events and business effects together
outbox failure rejects settlement
outbox failure leaves no trade position order receipt or event effects
concurrent settlement replay creates exactly two events
position event captures settlement-time quantity
later settlement does not mutate earlier position snapshot
later settlement gets its own resulting position snapshot
same-account settlement snapshots have increasing sequence numbers
event topics remain scoped to accepted account
migration refuses historical receipts without backfill
order-matcher cannot claim publisher events
order-matcher cannot acknowledge publisher events
trade-processor cannot claim publisher events
trade-processor cannot acknowledge publisher events
account-service cannot claim publisher events
account-service cannot acknowledge publisher events
publisher cannot mutate event payload
publisher cannot delete events
publisher cannot bypass claim function to read backlog
publisher cannot settle trades
claim bounds rejected (0,60)
claim bounds rejected (101,60)
claim bounds rejected (1,0)
claim bounds rejected (1,301)
concurrent publishers receive distinct live leases
another worker cannot acknowledge a live lease
wrong lease token cannot acknowledge
current worker and token acknowledge successfully
successful acknowledgment replay is idempotent
second publisher acknowledges its event
expired lease cannot acknowledge after restart
unacknowledged event replays with stable ID and payload after restart
reclaim fences old token and increments attempts
stale claim cannot acknowledge a reclaimed event
replacement publisher acknowledges replay
acknowledged events are not claimed again
all four immutable events retained after acknowledgment
notification retry and acknowledgment never reapply business settlement
limitations: Broker acceptance is simulated; no NATS publisher or durable broker acknowledgment is tested
Consumers must atomically deduplicate event IDs and reject stale position snapshot sequences
A compromised authorized publisher can falsely acknowledge its claims
Migration refuses existing receipts; deployed services and runtime images remain unchanged
